about: Queue for the Open Shoulders (Neck & Shoulders) mannequin clips, generated in the Gemini web app the same way as the Open Hips clips (Create video, Portrait, text only, one new chat per clip). DRAFT: the program in content/programs/shoulders.ts and these pose descriptions were written by Claude from general coaching knowledge; Felipe has not checked them yet.
template: A smooth beige 3D anatomy mannequin, male, faceless with no eyes and no mouth, visible ball joints at shoulders, elbows, wrists, knees and ankles, athletic build, wearing only black shorts, white crew socks and white sneakers. Dark gym, black rubber floor, neon green rim light from the right, nobody else in the room. {view}, static camera that never moves, entire body in frame, no tripod or camera equipment anywhere in the room. He starts already in this position: {start} He does only one movement: {motion} Exactly 3 slow repetitions, then he holds still in the starting position. He never changes position and never does any other movement. Working muscles: {glow}. They light up as glowing neon green anatomical muscle fibers drawn as a graphic overlay on top of the body and on top of the black shorts, so wherever a working muscle is under the shorts its glow shows on the shorts too, with visible fiber strands in the real shape of each muscle, brightest while the muscle works and dimmer when it rests. No red or skinless muscle anywhere: outside the green glow the body stays smooth plain beige. No cuts, no text. Portrait 9:16.
run_rules: Same run rules as assets/glossary/hips-queue.json (read its run_rules). Clips for this program go to public/programs/shoulders/clips/<exercise-slug>.mp4 and are listed in content/programs/program-clips.ts under "shoulders".

clips.name: Arm Circles
clips.start: standing tall, feet hip width apart, both arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height, palms facing down.
clips.motion: keeping the feet planted and the torso still, he draws big slow circles forward with both straight arms at the same time, the arms passing up, forward, down and back up through their full range. He never bends the elbows and never changes direction.
clips.glow: only both shoulder caps (the deltoids), the round muscles on top of each shoulder from the collarbone down to halfway along the upper arm. No glow on the chest, neck or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red
clips.note: 2026-11-27 ~12:55 Flow test, Omni 1.2 Flash (24 credits), 8 s 720x1280: style and glow match the Gemini clips exactly (green deltoids only, plain beige otherwise). Movement is close but not right: arms start down, elbows bend and the arms swing up rather than drawing straight-arm circles. Raw kept at assets/glossary/arm-circles-raw.mp4 in case Felipe accepts it. (A Veo 3.1 Lite test, 10 credits, came out in a different style with red skinless arm muscles: do not use Lite.)

clips.name: Scapular Push-ups
clips.start: in a high plank on the floor, hands under the shoulders, arms completely straight, feet together, body in one straight line from head to heels.
clips.motion: keeping the arms locked straight and the body rigid, he lets his chest sink a few centimetres between his shoulders so the shoulder blades squeeze together, then pushes the floor away so the upper back rounds slightly and the shoulder blades spread apart. The elbows never bend and he never does a real push-up.
clips.glow: only the serratus muscles on both sides of the ribcage under the armpits, the finger-like strips running from the shoulder blades around the ribs, and the muscles between the shoulder blades. No glow on the arms, chest or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Neck Side Stretch
clips.start: sitting cross-legged on the floor, spine tall, left hand resting on the left knee, right arm reaching over the top of the head with the right palm resting on the left side of the head above the left ear.
clips.motion: keeping the left shoulder low and the face looking straight ahead, he gently tilts his head to the right with the light weight of the right hand, bringing the right ear toward the right shoulder, pauses, then brings the head back upright. He never turns or nods the head and never switches hands.
clips.glow: only the left side of the neck, the muscle running from behind the left ear down the side of the neck to the top of the left shoulder (the upper trapezius). No glow on the right side, the arms or the legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Puppy Pose
clips.start: kneeling on all fours with the hips stacked right above the knees, both arms reaching far forward on the floor with the palms down, forehead close to the floor.
clips.motion: keeping the hips high above the knees and the hands planted far forward, he lets his chest melt down toward the floor between his arms, pauses, then lifts the chest back up a little. The hips never sit back onto the heels.
clips.glow: only the lats, the big wing-shaped muscles on both sides of the back from the armpits down to the lower back, and the back of both upper arms. No glow on the legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Chin Tucks
clips.start: sitting cross-legged on the floor, spine tall, hands resting on the knees, eyes looking straight ahead.
clips.motion: keeping the eyes level and the head upright, he slides his head straight back to make a double chin, pauses, then lets the head glide forward to neutral. He never nods up or down and never moves his shoulders.
clips.glow: only the deep muscles on the front of the neck, from under the jaw down to the collarbones, and the back of the neck at the base of the skull. No glow on the shoulders, arms or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Thread the Needle
clips.start: on all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips, back flat.
clips.motion: keeping the left hand planted and the hips right above the knees, he slides the right arm palm up under his chest along the floor to the left until his right shoulder and right ear rest on the floor, pauses, then pulls the right arm back and plants the right hand under the right shoulder. He only ever moves the right arm and never switches arms.
clips.glow: only the back of the right shoulder (the rear deltoid) and the muscles between the right shoulder blade and the spine. No glow on the left side or the legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Wall Chest Stretch
clips.start: standing with the right side of his body next to a wall, feet hip width apart, right arm straight out behind him at shoulder height with the right palm flat on the wall, left hand on the left hip.
clips.motion: keeping the right palm fixed on the wall and the right arm straight, he slowly turns his chest away from the wall to the left until the front of the right shoulder opens, pauses, then turns back. The right hand never leaves the wall and he never switches arms.
clips.glow: only the right chest muscle (the pectoral), from the breastbone across to the front of the right shoulder, and the front of the right shoulder. No glow on the left side, the back or the legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Cross Body Shoulder Stretch
clips.start: standing tall, feet hip width apart, right arm straight across the front of the chest at shoulder height, left forearm hooked over the right arm just above the right elbow.
clips.motion: keeping the right arm straight and both shoulders level, he uses the left forearm to pull the right arm closer across his chest, pauses, then eases it away a little. He never switches arms.
clips.glow: only the back of the right shoulder (the rear deltoid) and the muscles around the right shoulder blade. No glow on the left side, the chest or the legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Prone Y Raise
clips.start: lying face down on the floor, legs straight, forehead just above the floor, both arms straight overhead on the floor in a wide Y shape with the thumbs pointing up.
clips.motion: keeping both arms straight and the legs and chest on the floor, he lifts both arms a few centimetres off the floor by drawing the shoulder blades down and together, pauses, then lowers them. The legs and chest stay down.
clips.glow: only the lower trapezius and the rear shoulders, the muscles between and below both shoulder blades running down toward the middle of the back, and the back of both shoulders. No glow on the legs or the forearms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Clasped Hands Chest Opener
clips.start: standing tall, feet hip width apart, both arms straight behind his back with the fingers interlaced behind the hips.
clips.motion: keeping the arms straight and the torso upright, he lifts the clasped hands up and away from his back as far as they go while the chest opens, pauses, then lowers the hands back to the hips. He never bends forward.
clips.glow: only both chest muscles (the pectorals), from the breastbone out to the front of each shoulder, and the front of both shoulders. No glow on the back or the legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Side-Lying External Rotation
clips.start: lying on his left side on the floor, head resting on the straight left arm, knees slightly bent, right elbow bent at 90 degrees and pinned against the right side of his waist with the right forearm resting across his belly.
clips.motion: keeping the right elbow glued to his side, he rotates the right forearm up and out until it points at the ceiling, pauses, then lowers it slowly back across the belly. Only the right forearm moves and he never rolls over.
clips.glow: only the back of the right shoulder blade and the back of the right shoulder (the rotator cuff and rear deltoid). No glow on the left side, the chest or the legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Elevated Puppy Pose
clips.start: kneeling on the floor in front of a low box, hips stacked above the knees, both elbows resting on the box shoulder width apart, palms pressed together behind his head.
clips.motion: keeping the elbows on the box and the hips above the knees, he lets his chest and head sink down below the edge of the box toward the floor, pauses, then lifts the chest back up a little. The hips never sit back onto the heels.
clips.glow: only the lats, the big wing-shaped muscles on both sides of the back from the armpits down to the lower back, and the back of both upper arms (the triceps). No glow on the legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red
